title: board-watcher own-writes ledger entry
description: One line of own-writes.jsonl — the interop contract between a city's board write path and its board-watcher. The write path appends one entry per own write, immediately after the write lands on the board; the watcher suppresses a settled change when (file, sha256) matches any entry. sha256 '-' is a deletion tombstone recording an own removal.

file.description: Board doc basename (no path separators; leading alphanumeric).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the written content, or '-' for a deletion tombstone.

ts.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of when the write was recorded.
